columns.solar_template|electrical|elecregistry: Lowercase UUID with hyphens, 8-4-4-4-12 format. Always 36 characters, 1000 distinct values, no nulls.
columns.solar_template|electrical|engyunitref: Lowercase UUID string, 8-4-4-4-12 hyphen format. 1000 distinct values, no nulls.
columns.solar_template|electrical|efflogref: Lowercase UUID string, 8-4-4-4-12 hyphen format. 1000 distinct values, no nulls.
columns.solar_template|electrical|iscinita: Real current value with 1-2 decimal places, roughly 9-11 A. No nulls, 198 distinct values.
columns.solar_template|electrical|isccurra: Real current value with 1-2 decimal places, roughly 8-10 A. No nulls, 199 distinct values.
columns.solar_template|electrical|vocinitv: Real voltage with 1-2 decimal places, roughly 45-50 V. No nulls, 427 distinct values.
columns.solar_template|electrical|voccurrv: Numeric value of open-circuit voltage (Voc), stored as a real number in volts. Values range from 43.0 to 47.99, generally formatted as DD.DD or DD.D, with no NULLs.
columns.solar_template|electrical|impinita: Real current value with 1-2 decimal places, roughly 8-10 A. No nulls, 200 distinct values.
columns.solar_template|electrical|impcurra: Real current value with 1-2 decimal places, roughly 7-9 A. No nulls, 198 distinct values.
columns.solar_template|electrical|vmpinitv: Real voltage with 1-2 decimal places, roughly 35-40 V. No nulls, 431 distinct values.
columns.solar_template|electrical|vmpcurrv: Real voltage with 1-2 decimal places, roughly 33-38 V. No nulls, 433 distinct values.
columns.solar_template|electrical|ffactorinit: Real ratio with 2-3 decimal places, values between 0.75 and 0.85. No nulls, 101 distinct values.
columns.solar_template|electrical|ffactorcurr: Real ratio with 2-3 decimal places, values between 0.70 and 0.80. No nulls, 101 distinct values.
columns.solar_template|electrical|seriesresohm: Real resistance with 2-3 decimal places, values between 0.102 and 0.997 ohm. No nulls, 612 distinct values.
columns.solar_template|electrical|shuntresohm: Real resistance with one decimal, values between 201.7 and 999.8 ohm, always 5 characters. No nulls, 947 distinct values.
columns.solar_template|inverter|invertregistry: 36-character UUID string, unique per row. Identifies inverter registry entry.
columns.solar_template|inverter|siteref: 36-character UUID string referencing a site. Unique per row.
columns.solar_template|inverter|invertmoment: Date-time string in format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.microseconds'. Range spans 2015 to 2025.
columns.solar_template|inverter|inverttempc: Numeric temperature, one decimal place. Range 20.0 to 60.0 degrees Celsius.
columns.solar_template|inverter|gridvolt: Numeric voltage, one decimal place. Range 220.0 to 240.0 V.
columns.solar_template|inverter|gridfreqhz: Numeric frequency, up to two decimals. Range 49.5 to 50.5 Hz.
columns.solar_template|inverter|pwrqualidx: Numeric index between 0.002 and 0.999. Up to three decimal places.
columns.solar_template|inverter|power_metrics: JSON string containing harmonic distortion, reactive power, inverter efficiency, and power factor. Unique per row.
columns.solar_template|inverter|power_metrics.ha: Percentage value, range 0.01% to 5.0%. May be null. Usually one or two decimals.
columns.solar_template|inverter|power_metrics.re: Reactive power value, range -99.86 to 99.52. Can be negative or positive, up to two decimals.
columns.solar_template|inverter|power_metrics.in: Efficiency percentage, range 95.0% to 98.99%. Typically two decimals.
Power factor value, range 0.9 to 1.0. Dimensionless, typically three decimals.
columns.solar_template|panel|panemark: Always 36 characters in UUID format with hyphens, e.g. 00564c61-9386-4fbf-ab33-85ba0bde2515. All 1000 values distinct, no nulls.
columns.solar_template|panel|hubregistry: Always 36 characters in UUID format with hyphens. All 1000 values distinct, no nulls; same shape and value range as panemark.
columns.solar_template|panel|panemfr: Categorical text with five values: Longi, JA Solar, Trina, Canadian Solar, JinkoSolar. Lengths 5 to 14 chars, no nulls.
columns.solar_template|panel|paneline: Text values formatted as Model-100 through Model-999, always 9 characters with pattern AAAAA-DDD. 596 distinct values, many repeated, no nulls.
columns.solar_template|panel|panetype: Categorical text with five values: Bifacial, TOPCon, HJT, Poly-PERC, Mono-PERC. Lengths 3 to 9 chars, no nulls.
columns.solar_template|panel|powratew: Integer values 450, 500, 550, 600, 650. Five distinct categories, no nulls.
columns.solar_template|panel|paneeffpct: Real values from 18.01 to 23.0 percent, e.g. 21.21, 19.3, 22.4. 427 distinct values, no nulls.
columns.solar_template|panel|nomtempc: Real values from 42.0 to 48.0 degrees C, one decimal place. 61 distinct values, no nulls.
columns.solar_template|panel|tempcoef: Negative real values from -0.35 to -0.45, e.g. -0.432, -0.351, -0.37. 101 distinct values, no nulls.
columns.solar_template|performance|perfregistry: 36-char UUID, unique per row, 1000 distinct values. Primary key-like identifier for performance entry.
columns.solar_template|performance|solmodref: 36-char UUID, unique per row, 1000 distinct values. Identifies associated solar module.
columns.solar_template|performance|perfmoment: Timestamp string 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.ffffff', 25-26 chars, range 2015-03 to 2025-02, unique per row.
columns.solar_template|performance|measpoww: Real number, range 382.68-648.18 W, values like 624.26. Measures power output at performance moment.
columns.solar_template|performance|powlossw: Real number, range 0.15-97.17 W, one null. Represents power loss compared to expected output.
columns.solar_template|performance|efficiency_pr: Contains degradation (cumdegpct, anndegrate) and current_efficiency (curreffpct, efflosspct) fields. Values are numeric or null.
Number, range 0.03-15.0, one null. Cumulative efficiency degradation in degradation object.
Number, range 0.3-1.2, no nulls. Yearly degradation rate in degradation object.
Number, range 15.01-21.0, no nulls. Current operating efficiency in current_efficiency object.
Number, range -2.7 to 7.66, no nulls. Efficiency loss relative to reference in current_efficiency object.
columns.solar_template|alerts|alertreg: 36-character UUID unique per row. Identifies alert registration record.
columns.solar_template|alerts|compreg: 36-character UUID unique per row. References component registration.
columns.solar_template|alerts|deviceref: 36-character UUID unique per row. Identifies device associated with alert.
columns.solar_template|alerts|incidentref: 36-character UUID unique per row. Links alert to incident.
columns.solar_template|alerts|alertmoment: Format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.ffffff, length 25-26. Stores exact time alert triggered.
columns.solar_template|alerts|alertcnt: Integer values 1 to 10. Nullable, counts alert occurrences.
columns.solar_template|plant|growregistry: TEXT(36). Always 36 chars, formatted as UUID: 8-4-4-4-12 hex digits with hyphens. 1000 distinct values, no NULLs. Example: '00564c61-9386-4fbf-ab33-85ba0bde2515'.
columns.solar_template|plant|growalias: TEXT(100). Pattern 'Solar Plant <PlaceName>'. Length 18-34 chars. Mostly unique, some duplicates (2 each). Example: 'Solar Plant Woodardtown'.
columns.solar_template|plant|gencapmw: REAL. Numeric values from 1.44 to 99.04. Mostly distinct, few duplicates. Format varies: D.DD to DDD.DD. Example: 471.0, 82.89.
columns.solar_template|plant|initdate: TEXT(10). Always ISO date format YYYY-MM-DD. Range from 2015-03-03 to 2024-02-20. 860 distinct dates. Example: '2019-09-13'.
columns.solar_template|environment|envregistry: 36-character UUID, e.g. '00564c61-...'. All values distinct; identifies each environment record.
columns.solar_template|environment|arearegistry: 36-character UUID, e.g. 'ffb6a6cb-...'. All values distinct; references an area registry entry.
columns.solar_template|environment|envmoment: String timestamp with microseconds, format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.ffffff'. One value per measurement moment.
columns.solar_template|environment|celltempc: Real number about 25.1 to 75.0°C, one decimal, format 'DD.D'.
columns.solar_template|environment|ambtempc: Real number with one decimal; values include negative and values above 40°C, e.g. -0.1, 35.1, 42.4.
columns.solar_template|environment|soillosspct: Real number with one or two decimals, e.g. 0.02, 3.86, 10.12, 14.87. Unit is percent.
columns.solar_template|environment|dustdengm2: Real number roughly 0.006 to 4.993; formats 'D.DDD', 'D.DD', 'D.D'. Likely grams per square meter.
columns.solar_template|environment|cleancycleday: Integer values like 9, 12, 21, 54, 56; one or two digits; number of days in a cleaning cycle.
columns.solar_template|environment|relhumpct: Real number 0.1 to 99.9, one decimal, unit percent.
columns.solar_template|environment|windspdms: Real number about 0.1 to 23.7 m/s, one decimal, format 'D.D' or 'DD.D'.
columns.solar_template|environment|winddirdeg: Real number with one decimal, e.g. 0.1, 221.6, 336.7, 359.1; unit degrees.
columns.solar_template|environment|preciptmm: Real number with one decimal, e.g. 1.7, 13.9, 46.8; unit mm.
columns.solar_template|environment|airpresshpa: Real number around 934.7 to 1097.7 hPa, one decimal, formats 'DDD.D' or 'DDDD.D'.
columns.solar_template|environment|uv_idx: Real number with one decimal, e.g. 0.1, 3.4, 8.0, 11.1; index units.
columns.solar_template|environment|cloudcovpct: Real number 0.1 to 99.9, one decimal, unit percent.
columns.solar_template|environment|snowcovpct: Real number 0.1 to 99.9, one decimal, unit percent.
columns.solar_template|environment|irradiance_co: Contains JSON object with keys 'specmisfac' (number) and 'irradiance_types' (array of four numbers). String length about 72–78 characters.
Number between 0.95 and 1.05, e.g. 0.973, 1.026; one to three decimals; dimensionless.
JSON array of four numbers, e.g. [1002.00, 149.8, 143.100, 1156.400]; values roughly 0.7 to 1155; likely W/m².
columns.solar_template|maintenance|maintregistry: 36-char UUID string. No nulls, all distinct. One record per row.
columns.solar_template|maintenance|powerref: 36-char UUID string. No nulls, all distinct. Identifies associated power item.
columns.solar_template|maintenance|compref: 36-char UUID string. No nulls, all distinct. Identifies associated component.
columns.solar_template|maintenance|obsref: 36-char UUID string. No nulls, all distinct. Identifies associated observation.
columns.solar_template|maintenance|inspectmeth: Category text. Four values: 'EL Imaging', 'Visual', 'IR Thermal', 'IV Curve'. No nulls.
columns.solar_template|maintenance|inspectres: Category text. Three values: 'Pass', 'Minor Issues', 'Major Issues'. No nulls.
columns.solar_template|maintenance|inspectdate: ISO date format YYYY-MM-DD. No nulls. Range from 2024-08-23 to 2025-02-19.
columns.solar_template|maintenance|maintsched: Category text. Three values: 'On Schedule', 'Delayed', 'Overdue'. No nulls.
columns.solar_template|maintenance|wtystatus: Category text. Three values: 'Active', 'Claimed', 'Expired'. No nulls.
columns.solar_template|maintenance|wtyclaimcnt: Integer from 1 to 5. 156 nulls. No null values show claim count.
columns.solar_template|maintenance|maintcostusd: Decimal dollar amount. No nulls. Values varied, roughly 1000 to 9996.
columns.solar_template|maintenance|cleancostusd: Decimal dollar amount. No nulls. Values varied, roughly 100 to 5000.
columns.solar_template|maintenance|replacecostus: Decimal dollar amount. No nulls. Values varied, from small to tens of thousands.
columns.solar_template|maintenance|revlossusd: Decimal dollar amount. No nulls. Values varied, mostly thousands.
